title: 星屑の天球儀と、深海に眠る約束
author: 星見 ユラ

en.title: Stardust Astrolabe and the Promise Beneath the Deep Sea
en.premise: Sora, a girl who can hear the voices of stars, meets Kai, a boy with amnesia washed up on a beach one night. Kai is a survivor of the star‑falling village that vanished centuries ago. Together they set out to recover lost memories and their hometown, using constellations as keys to a mirror‑shaped ruin hidden beneath the deep sea.

zh.title: 星尘天球仪与深海沉睡的约定
zh.premise: 星之声可聆听的少女ソラ，在某个夜晚遇见了被冲上岸的失忆少年カイ。カイ的真实身份是数百年前突然消失的“星降村”的幸存者。两人携手以星座为钥匙，踏上寻找失落记忆与故乡的旅程，前往深海底部沉睡的镜像遗迹。

prediction_results.question: ナイトは何者なのか、次はどう動く？
